notes: Two full-screen editor fixes. (1) Selecting text on the preview put the transform/resize box in the wrong place (top-left, over the content rail) because the editor set the preview wrapper to position:static — it's now position:relative, so the box hugs the text in the centre. (2) Selecting a layer (Background/media, Text, etc.) revealed tall controls that scrolled the whole stage and pushed the centre preview out of view — each column (content rail + properties) is now height-capped to the stage and scrolls on its own, so the preview stays fixed and the view never jumps.
